evidence: RUNTIME HALF: stated. Path /app (instruction.md:5, integration.md:3); start command 'node /app/server.js' from a cwd that may be outside /app (integration.md:3; test.sh:97-111 may launch /tmp/submission/server.js); 0.0.0.0:3000 (integration.md:3; test.sh:108); GET /api/health (integration.md:3; test.sh:48); SQLite default /app/app.db with absolute DB_PATH override 'including when the app runs from a writable copy outside /app' (integration.md:9; test.sh:98-109); Node 22, Express, better-sqlite3 via NODE_PATH and no install/build step (integration.md:5; test.sh:106); seed /assets/seed_data.json (instruction.md:3, integration.md:7); restart durability (integration.md:7,9); symlink rule (integration.md:11; test.sh:72-83); accounts: none, stated (instruction.md:5, overview.md:3, policy.md:3; app_context.md:10). Fixed clock: not stated and not needed - the seed has no dates and no criterion grades a date or time-of-day figure. COVERAGE HALF: 51 of 52 criteria trace to a public sentence in the six notes. One does not: tests/scored/polish/judge.toml:32 (cw_controls_feedback_and_labels) requires that 'a Run that completes, a Run that throws an error, and a successful Save' each leave 'a status, message or console entry [that] must say in words what happened' and 'Fails ... if any of the three actions ends with no visible textual feedback'. The brief asks for feedback only on failures and conflicts: error message for a throw (behaviour.md:3), reason for throw/stop/time limit (behaviour.md:5), 'useful conflict feedback' (behaviour.md:9), 'say so' for a newer revision (behaviour.md:11), 'clear feedback' for refused dynamic code (security.md:5), a formatting error (ui.md:15), and an unsaved marker that 'goes away after Save' (ui.md:17). Nothing asks for a worded confirmation of a successful Save or of a Run that completes normally. The same unasked observation is a step of the constraints gate: gates/constraints/judge.toml:32 'see that the app reports the Save as successful' (not in its Fails list, but functional prompt-style conjunction reading could apply). REVIEW_POLICY 'No hidden requirements' names notification text explicitly. Secondary, lower confidence (Note level): functional/judge.toml:137 fails Find when 'matches are only decorated and never become the current selection'; ui.md:11 asks for next/previous matches and a 'current match' but never says the match must become the editor selection. Scripted golden passes this polish criterion (results/polish.json, hash verified) only because the golden happens to print 'Saved ... revision N' (solution/app/src/app.tsx:69) - a golden default, not a public requirement. No configured judge run exists, so impact on a real builder is unmeasured.
counterexample: Conforming alternative that fails: an app that implements every sentence of the six notes; on a successful Save the unsaved-changes marker disappears (ui.md:17) and the library row and history update, with no 'Saved' text; a Run that completes simply renders the preview and whatever the program logged. Per polish/judge.toml:32 the judge must fail cw_controls_feedback_and_labels (1/6 of polish, about 3.3 percent of reward) because the Save 'ends with no visible textual feedback', and a strict judge may also stall on the gate step 'see that the app reports the Save as successful' (constraints/judge.toml:32), which would zero the whole reward. Broken app that passes: not applicable to this defect; the runtime half found none.
suggested_fix: Either add one public sentence (for example in ui.md:17: 'Say in words when a Run finishes and when a Save succeeds') or narrow polish/judge.toml:32 to the feedback the brief asks for (thrown-error message, refused or conflicting Save, readable control names), and reword constraints/judge.toml:32 to 'see the snippet appear in the library' instead of 'the app reports the Save as successful'. Optionally state in ui.md:11 that the current Find match becomes the selection, or drop the 'only decorated' fail clause at functional/judge.toml:137.
